<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal used for synchronous write operations.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal used for synchronous read operations.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal. Used to trigger write operations.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal. Used to trigger read operations.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal. Indicates if the FIFO is full and cannot accept further write operations.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal. Indicates if the FIFO is empty and cannot provide any data for read operations.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="WIDTH" value="8"/>
        <parameter name="DEPTH" value="16"/>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <signal id="waddr_bin" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
        <signal id="raddr_bin" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
        <signal id="wptr" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
        <signal id="rptr" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
        <signal id="wptr_syn" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
        <signal id="rptr_syn" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
        <signal id="wptr_buff" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
        <signal id="rptr_buff" type="reg" width_description="$clog2(DEPTH)"/>
        <signal id="wen" type="wire"/>
        <signal id="ren" type="wire"/>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Initialize pointers and buffers
        always @(posedge wclk or posedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (winc && !wfull) begin
                    waddr_bin <= (waddr_bin + 1) % DEPTH;
                    wptr <= waddr_bin;
                    wptr_buff <= waddr_bin;
                end
            end
        end

        always @(posedge rclk or posedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (rinc && !rempty) begin
                    raddr_bin <= (raddr_bin + 1) % DEPTH;
                    rptr <= raddr_bin;
                    rptr_buff <= raddr_bin;
                end
            end
        end

        // Convert pointers to Gray code
        assign wptr = (wptr_buff ^ (wptr_buff >> 1));
        assign rptr = (rptr_buff ^ (rptr_buff >> 1));

        // Synchronize pointers for full/empty detection
        always @(posedge wclk) begin
            wptr_syn <= wptr;
        end

        always @(posedge rclk) begin
            rptr_syn <= rptr;
        end

        // Full and empty signals
        assign wfull = (wptr_syn == {~rptr_syn[msb(rptr_syn)], rptr_syn[$bits(rptr_syn)-2:0]});
        assign rempty = (rptr_syn == wptr_syn);

        // Control signals for RAM
        assign wen = (winc && !wfull);
        assign ren = (rinc && !rempty);

        // Connect RAM
        dual_port_RAM #(.DEPTH(DEPTH), .WIDTH(WIDTH)) ram (
            .wclk(wclk),
            .wenc(wen),
            .waddr(waddr_bin),
            .wdata(wdata),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .renc(ren),
            .raddr(raddr_bin),
            .rdata(rdata)
        );
    </implementation>
</module>
